description: The documented guidance describes how dynamic simulation supports alternative thermal-storage system configurations, operating strategies and scenarios in early opportunity assessment. It connects outputs with technical, economic and environmental indicators for selecting integration concepts. It is an infrastructure simulation reference document, not an implemented platform or a newly released model. The available native description does not identify individual model names, executable endpoints or case input tables. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results. The native deposit declares CC-BY-4.0 and public access without a stated charge.
